tradition.name: Belarusian metal
tradition.lineage: Belarusian metal includes Adliga’s Belarusian-language doom/post-metal recordings. Defaults are a present-day authored realization, not a historical session reconstruction.

extras.description: Vobrazy documents guitarists Ignat Pomazkov and Uladzimir Burylau, vocalists Burylau and Kate Sidelova, bassist Roman Petrashkevich and drummer Artem Voronko. This selects that band configuration. Electric-guitar/bass subtypes and recording defaults are authored present-day choices, not documented session equipment; Minsk pin marks the explicitly credited 2020–2021 Everest Studio recording, not the band’s current Vilnius address. Room, chain and numeric axes are authored present-day recording choices.

tradition.name: Black metal argentino
tradition.lineage: Argentine black metal includes the Buenos Aires practice of Nekro Cvlt Desecration, a band formed in Venezuela and based in Argentina since2018. Defaults are a present-day authored realization, not a historical session reconstruction.

extras.description: The artist’s current lineup lists Ereshkigal on bass, Seth Nekromancer on voice, Nashgot on guitar and Hexensabbat on drums. This models the present Buenos Aires lineup; it does not relocate the distinct 2016 album session to Argentina. Selected instrument types, room and signal chain are authored present-day recording choices. Room, chain and numeric axes are authored present-day recording choices.
